81.content: On (, On; "Malice") is one of the defining features of the movie Hunter × Hunter: The Last Mission. It is the opposite of Nen. Instead of utilizing life energy, the aura from On is derived from hatred and can be considered "death energy." On grants one immense strength, with each user being able to utilize abilities similar to Nen at 100% efficiency. Unlike Nen, this aura is said to be the stronger of the two and has no categories; meaning, one who masters On has the ability of an Enhancer, Transmuter, Conjurer, Emitter, Manipulator, and Specialist.

570.content:
Q (, Kyū) is an encryption software in the Hunter × Hunter world.

By sending a nine-digit code to a phone company held by the Hunter Association, a Hunter can send and receive information via this special software. There are no logs and no call history, and regular wiretapping systems cannot detect this method of data transfer.

571.content:
There are various types of vehicles in the Hunter × Hunter world.

Airships are a type of aircraft widely used for long-distance travel. They are spacious enough to include bars, lounges, and bedrooms. The first airship seen in the series is used by Chairman Netero when he visits the participants of the 287th Hunter Exam during the Second Phase. Lingon Airport near Yorknew City seems to have only airships, as does the Hunter Association. This suggests that blimps are the prevalent means of aerial transportation, whereas airplanes do not seem to exist at all.

Cyclops (, 1tsu Me Kyojin) is a Greed Island monster that lives in the hills.

Cyclops are a group of one-eyed humanoid giants that uses blunt weapons. They prefer to move in groups and will attack anything that goes inside their territory, found in the mountains on the way to Masadora city. They collapse when they are hit in the eye.

583.content:
The Melanin Lizard (メラニントカゲ, Meranin Tokage) is a Greed Island monster that lives in the hills.

It is a large lizard that can swallow a whole cow. It can use its huge body to pin down and kill its victim by suffocation. This lizard has a mole on its back that is very vulnerable to attacks that is hidden by many other spots used as camouflage. Biscuit claims that it is not hard to observe which spot the lizard guards carefully.

Mike (ミケ, Mike) is the guard dog of the Zoldyck Estate.

Mike is an enormous hound with white (Tyrian purple in the 2011 anime adaptation) fur and a blue tongue (pink in the 2011 anime adaptation). In both 1999 anime adaptation and manga, he is robust. 594.content:
Rabid Dog (, Yamainu) was a member of the Shadow Beasts, the elite guard of the Ten Dons.

Rabid Dog was a lanky man with spiky, messy hair, pointy ears, and pronounced cheekbones. His sharp-filed teeth were his most distinctive feature. 596.content:
The World Trees (, Sekaiju) are a type of tree that is found mostly within the Dark Continent.

The World Trees are the tallest type of tree that put their roots on a mountain range, intake magma, surpass the atmosphere, and become even bigger. They grow mostly in the "outside" world but at least one of them is in the "known" world. The World Tree in the "known" world is only a sapling that has only enough nutrients to grow 1784 meters (approx. 1.11 mi.). When Gon climbed the tree to meet Ging, there was a nest which contained an unknown species of a huge bird.
